properties.NAME: MOHAVE
properties.CHANGE: MOHAVE lost when the United States transferred a portion of northwestern Arizona Territory to the state of Nevada. Arizona twice petitioned Congress to repeal the act and did not recognize the change until 18 Feb 1871.
properties.CITATION: (U.S. Stat., vol. 14, ch. 73[1866]/p. 43; Sacks, 25; Van Zandt, p. 158, 165)
